standard_prerequisites.name: Finite flat equivalence global
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, proposition finite-flat-equivalence-global (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: The quotient is an algebraic space.

core_obligations: Let U be the punctured spectrum of the normal local ring A; its normalization Y -> U is finite.
The groupoid R = Y x_U Y is a finite flat equivalence relation on Y.
The finite-flat-equivalence proposition identifies U with the quotient Y/R, giving the displayed algebraic space structure.
proof_roadmap: Finite normalization; groupoid of the cover; quotient identification.
difficulty_reason: A three-step presentation argument; the quotient identification is the substance.
